messages.author: 4f9701b3dc2dae8c
messages.subject: More room for facet title
parts:
Hi,

I'd like to make more room for the facet title, e.g.,

d <- data.frame(x=rnorm(100), y=rnorm(100), class=sample(c("class1",
"class2"), 100, TRUE))
ggplot(d, aes(x, y)) + geom_point() + facet_grid(. ~ class)

How do I make the gray box surrounding the facet title taller?

Thanks,
Gad

messages.subject: Re: More room for facet title
parts:
Hi,

Looking at this link provided today, 
https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/wiki/Faceting-Attributes
I'd be tempted to think that theme_text for strip.text.x would also accept the lineheight argument, but it has no effect, or at least no perceptible effect.

J
